metadata.label: Distant Jellies
metadata.description: Adds faint tiny jellyfish drifting upward in the background; mids brighten them.

image.label: Image
image.description: Scene image to add distant jellyfish to.

controlDescriptions.brightness: Glow strength of the distant jellyfish.
controlDescriptions.hue: Base color of the distant jellyfish.

metadata.label: Jellyfish Bell
metadata.description: Glowing translucent jellyfish bell over deep space; bass contracts the bell.

controlDescriptions.armCount: Number of frilly oral arms near the centre.
controlDescriptions.armLength: Oral arm length relative to the tentacles.
controlDescriptions.dotSpacing: How many dots appear along each tentacle.
controlDescriptions.dotSpeed: How fast glowing dots flow down the tentacles.
controlDescriptions.dotSpeedVariation: How much dot speed differs between tentacles.
controlDescriptions.lengthVariation: How much shorter some tentacles are.
controlDescriptions.pulse: How strongly bass contracts the bell.
controlDescriptions.sway: How strongly mids make the tentacles sway.
controlDescriptions.tentacleLength: Longest tentacle length relative to bell size.

metadata.label: Cosmic Nebula
metadata.description: Adds a dim drifting magenta and teal gas nebula near the screen edges; bass brightens it gently.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image to add the nebula behind.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image with a faint nebula added.

controlDescriptions.bassGlow: How strongly bass brightens the nebula.

controlDescriptions.drift: How fast the gas clouds drift.
controlDescriptions.hue: Tint blended into the magenta and teal gas.
controlDescriptions.scale: Size of the cloud features. Higher values give smaller clouds.
